ns2:course.label: Intro Romance Ling
ns2:course.description: (SPAN 362) Comparative and historical analysis of the Romance languages. Same as FR 562, ITAL 556, LING 556, PORT 556, and RMLG 556. Prerequisite: Four semesters of a Romance language or Latin, or equivalent; LING 100, SPAN 302, FR 416, or equivalent.
